title: Collision Montage / Meaning From Incompatible Shots
observed_structure: two shots preserve distinct material facts
their adjacency creates a third proposition not stated by either shot
the edit changes causal or ideological interpretation
cinematic_affordances: graphic or rhythmic conflict at the cut
human action juxtaposed with institutional machinery
repeated collision with one changed term
cultural_scope: Soviet formal tradition; retain historical provenance and do not flatten into generic fast cutting
transferable_structure: adjacent incompatible images generate a third readable proposition that changes dramatic interpretation
non_transferable_surface: recreating Odessa Steps imagery, propaganda iconography, or copying historical compositions
